ops.d: List every topics in the subscription.
List the topics in a resource group.
List every domains in the subscription.
List the domains in a resource group.
List every systemTopics in the subscription.
List the systemTopics in a resource group.
Run a KQL-subset query (Resources / ResourceContainers; where, project, limit, order by, count) over the ARM store.

in.query: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.eventgrid/topics' | project name, location | limit 5

s:
az rest --skip-authorization-header --headers "Authorization=Bearer dev" --method post \
  --url "{EP}/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-cloudlearn01/providers/Microsoft.ResourceGraph/resources?api-version=2022-10-01" \
  --body '{"query":"Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.eventgrid/topics' | project name, location | limit 5"}'

az extension add -n resource-graph
az graph query -q "Resources | project name, type | limit 5"   # after `az cloud set` to this environment

import requests

r = requests.post("{EP}/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-cloudlearn01/providers/Microsoft.ResourceGraph/resources?api-version=2022-10-01",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer dev"},
    json={"query": "Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.eventgrid/topics' | project name, location | limit 5"})
print(r.status_code, r.json() if r.content else "")

curl -s -X POST "{EP}/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-cloudlearn01/providers/Microsoft.ResourceGraph/resources?api-version=2022-10-01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer dev" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.eventgrid/topics' | project name, location | limit 5"}'

features.t: Topics — create, list, get, update, delete (generic ARM catalog)
"Open query" (Azure Resource Graph Explorer) and "Assign tags" on the Topics list
x: "Open query" runs a real Azure Resource Graph query (Microsoft.ResourceGraph/resources) over the ARM engine's own resource store: table Resources/ResourceContainers with where/project/limit/order by/count - not a canned response, but not full Kusto either (no joins, summarize or time-series operators; unsupported operators are a 400). "Assign tags" PATCHes real ARM tags onto every selected topic.

features.t: "Assign tags" bulk action on the Topics list

Toolbar actions of a topic's Activity log and Locks panels: Export Activity Logs, Insights, Pin current filters and the Locks Subscription/Resource group scope buttons (real or local); Feedback (not simulated)
x: Export Activity Logs is a real subscription-scope Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings: new Administrative events are delivered to the chosen Log Analytics workspace (AzureDiagnostics) and/or storage account (container insights-activity-logs). Event Hub destinations are not served (no Event Hubs receiver). Only the Administrative category has an event source in Vyomi; Security/Policy/Alert/etc. can be enabled but never receive events. The Locks Subscription/Resource group buttons list the real Microsoft.Authorization/locks at that scope.

features.t: Access keys (listKeys / regenerateKey)
Event subscriptions on a topic — create, list, get, update, delete (destination, filters)
x: providers/azure_services.py routes the Microsoft.EventGrid/eventSubscriptions extension-resource reentry to the SAME core/azure_eventgrid_core.py engine Nano uses, over its own ARM state — the appliance is no longer behind Nano here.

features.t: Dead-lettering and retry policy (max delivery attempts, event TTL, expiration time)
x: Expiration time IS enforced: an event subscription past its expirationTimeUtc is swept (auto-deleted, same as real Event Grid) before any GET/list sees it. deadLetterDestination is honored to decide dead-lettered vs dropped on a failed delivery (azure.eventgrid.eventsubscriptions.delivery). maxDeliveryAttempts and eventTimeToLiveInMinutes round-trip (PUT/GET) but are not enforced as a literal attempt count / TTL countdown — there is no background retry scheduler to count attempts against (same simplification as EventBridge Scheduler's lazy firing), so a failed delivery resolves to its terminal outcome immediately rather than after N retries over the configured window.

features.t: Event delivery (filter matching, pushing to the destination endpoint, retries, dead-lettering)
x: REAL on publish (core/azure_eventgrid_core.py publish()/deliver(), POST {topic.properties.endpoint}): every live event subscription's filter (subjectBeginsWith/EndsWith + case sensitivity, includedEventTypes, a bounded subset of advancedFilters operators) is actually evaluated against the event, and a ServiceBusQueue/ServiceBusTopic destination is actually delivered to — the message lands in that Service Bus entity's real backlog (core/azure_servicebus_core.py), readable back over its own native wire.

features.t: Namespaces — create, list, delete (generic ARM catalog)
x: The MQTT broker and client/topic-space configuration on a namespace are not modeled — only the resource itself round-trips.

features.t: System topics — create, list, delete (generic ARM catalog)
x: The source resource / topic type a system topic listens to is stored as configured but no Azure-service event is ever generated or delivered.

features.t: Domains — create, list, delete (generic ARM catalog)
x: Domain topics (the per-topic children of a domain) are not modeled — only the domain resource itself round-trips.

features.t: Partner configurations — create, list, delete (generic ARM catalog)
x: Partner authorization approval workflows are not modeled — only the configuration resource round-trips.

features.t: Partner topics — create, list, delete (generic ARM catalog)
x: Partner topic activation by the partner and event delivery from a partner are not modeled.

features.t: Partner registrations — create, list, delete (generic ARM catalog)
x: Becoming a listed Event Grid partner is not modeled — only the registration resource round-trips.

features.t: Partner namespaces — create, list, delete (generic ARM catalog)
x: Partner namespace channels and partner destinations are not modeled — only the namespace resource round-trips.

features.t: Topic activity log
x: A simplified, generic ARM activity feed (create/update/delete on this resource), not the real Microsoft.Insights audit trail (callers, correlation ids, full operation metadata).

features.t: Access control (IAM) on a topic
x: Role assignments and role definitions are real ARM resources (Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments, roleDefinitions), but the generic ARM list is subscription-wide (not scoped to this one topic), and 'Check access' / 'My access' evaluation is not modelled — Vyomi never denies a console action based on a role assignment.

features.t: Resource locks
x: CanNotDelete and ReadOnly locks on the topic itself ARE enforced (a locked topic's write/delete is rejected with 409 ScopeLocked, same as real ARM). The lock does not cascade to the topic's event subscriptions, which are dispatched by a separate extension-resource module (core/azure_eventgrid_core.py) and are never blocked by a lock on their parent topic.

features.t: Alerts, metrics, diagnostic settings and logs on a topic
x: Metrics shows REAL counters derived from actual publish/delivery activity (PublishSuccessCount, MatchedEventCount, DeliverySuccessCount, DeliveryAttemptFailCount, DeadLetteredCount, DroppedEventCount — core/azure_eventgrid_core.py, never synthetic/random data), not the generic Microsoft.Insights/metrics time-series engine: no time-grain selection, chart rendering or aggregation-type picker.

features.t: Diagnose and solve problems
x: Runs a fixed set of REAL checks against this topic's actual configuration and delivery counters (event subscriptions present, delivery failures without a dead-letter destination, a blocking ReadOnly lock, public network access) — not Microsoft's actual diagnostics knowledge base, ML-driven root-cause analysis or automated remediation flows.

features.t: Tasks
x: Tasks (Azure DevOps/Boards work-item integration) depends on a real external product/account this simulator has no counterpart for. Diagnose and solve problems is real (azure.eventgrid.topic.diagnose) and Support + Troubleshooting is the shared support-request panel (azure.common.support).

features.t: Export template (ARM template / Bicep / Terraform)
x: The ARM Template tab renders this topic's own live resource JSON (type/apiVersion/properties), the same data as Overview's JSON View, in the standard ARM deployment-template envelope — real, not a static sample. Bicep and Terraform output, and the Add to library / Deploy / Visualize template actions, are not modeled.

features.t: Event subscriptions on a resource's own system events (storage, Key Vault, App Configuration, API Management, resource group)
x: Subscriptions are real Microsoft.EventGrid/eventSubscriptions scoped to the resource (create/list/get/delete, event types validated against what that resource type raises, expiration swept, per-subscription matched/delivered/failed counters). A resource group's (and the subscription's) subscriptions receive REAL Microsoft.Resources.ResourceWriteSuccess/ResourceDeleteSuccess events from every actual ARM write/delete in it.
